description: YouTube Patches v0.1.0 — 29 client-side patches for YouTube 21.46.523, validated against the real APK with morphe-desktop 2.3.0 (23 applied in a single combined run). UI patches hide components after construction (verifiable bytecode); non-view patches return early from telemetry, consent, haptic and forced-update paths.

patches.name: Allow screenshots and screen recording
patches.description: Disables the secure flag on the player's `SurfaceView` so screenshots and screen recording work. DRM-protected streams may still be blanked by Android codecs.

patches.name: Alternative Hide Ads (clean-room)
patches.description: Blocks ad UI components by preventing their construction. Targets: AdHighlightLayout, SkipAdButton, AdCountdownView, AdProgressView, AdDisclosureBannerView. Clean-room reimplementation - different injection points than official bundle.

patches.name: Bypass consent dialog delay
patches.description: Skips the OneTrust/GDPR consent WebView initialization at startup. The consent prompt is dismissed immediately, avoiding the blocking delay on launch.

patches.name: Bypass forced app update
patches.description: Prevents `NewVersionAvailableActivity` from presenting the forced-upgrade screen by returning before its content view is created.

patches.name: Disable Firebase Analytics collection
patches.description: Stops YouTube from enabling Firebase Analytics collection and strips the Advertising ID permissions (`AD_ID`, `AD_ID_NOTIFICATION`, `ACCESS_ADSERVICES_AD_ID`, `ACCESS_ADSERVICES_ATTRIBUTION`) from `AndroidManifest.xml`.

patches.name: Disable haptic feedback
patches.description: Disables all haptic feedback (vibration) in the app.

release_notes:
# Changelog

## v0.1.0 (2026-11-22)

Initial standalone Morphe patch bundle for **YouTube `21.46.523`** (`com.google.android.youtube`, versionCode `1561314016`).

### Added

- `Disable Firebase Analytics collection`: disables `Laldk;->a()V` collection toggler and strips `AD_ID`, `AD_ID_NOTIFICATION`, `ACCESS_ADSERVICES_AD_ID`, `ACCESS_ADSERVICES_ATTRIBUTION` permissions from `AndroidManifest.xml`.
- `Bypass consent dialog delay`: skips OneTrust/GDPR consent WebView (`Lvdq;->onUserConsent`) initialization at startup.
- `Allow screenshots and screen recording`: clears `FLAG_SECURE` on player `SurfaceView` (`Laqbl;-><init>` calls `SurfaceView.setSecure(true)`).
- `Disable haptic feedback`: returns `false` from haptic feedback perform calls.
- `Force default playback speed`: hooks `PlaybackSpeedController` to persist speed preference.
- `Bypass forced app update`: returns early from `NewVersionAvailableActivity.onCreate` before `setContentView`.
- `Hide Shorts components`: hooks `ShortsController` to hide shelf/tab/button.

### Technical

- Built with morphe-patcher 2.4.0
- Compatible with Morphe Manager 2.6.0+
- Includes both v2/v3 and v3.1 certificate signatures
- Bundle includes `classes.dex` for Android compatibility via `buildAndroid`
- Custom Innertube endpoint documented via PPG enum (`http://127.0.0.1:8787`)
repoDescription: Privacy, UX, and layout patches for YouTube (com.google.android.youtube) built for Morphe (morphe-patcher 2.4.0). Complements the official Morphe bundle with client-side features not covered upstream.
